title: Payroll Load Limits, Off-Cycle Allowances and Correction Fees — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
## Load terms by package

The Paystride Payroll Card Program sets, for each package, the largest single payroll load to one card, the off-cycle batches per calendar month carried without fee, the fee per off-cycle batch beyond that allowance, the fee for correcting a load file after it was accepted, and the business days within which a load refused by a card account is credited back to the funding balance.

| Package | Largest single load to one card (USD) | Off-cycle batches per calendar month without fee | Fee per off-cycle batch beyond the allowance (USD) | Load file correction fee (USD) | Business days to credit back a refused load |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 5000.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 5000.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 7500.00 | 1 | 3.00 | 20.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 7500.00 | 2 | 3.00 | 15.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 10000.00 | 4 | 0.00 | 10.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 10000.00 | 10 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2 |

### Worker protections, every package

| Term | All six packages |
|---|---|
| Each worker's written, voluntary consent on file before their card is loaded | required |
| Employer offers each worker direct deposit or a check instead of the card | required |

### Points of reference

- The Essential and Standard packages carry no off-cycle batch without fee, so each off-cycle batch is beyond the allowance.
- The Premier and Elite packages carry no off-cycle fee.
- Hypothetical reading: under the Advantage package a third off-cycle batch in one calendar month is beyond the allowance of 2, at a fee of 3.00; the first and second carry none.
